items.title: I found a bug in the CPU AI.
items.text:
I found a bug in the CPU AI.
So I wanted to make a space stage.  I made 2 falling platforms to start in, the bottom half of the stage has 100% wind blowing up, and 50% blowing up on the top half I believe.  Anyways, the flying part works well, just use your jumps sparingly and try not to Up B.  

However, what sucks is that the level 9 CPU has no idea what to do, and just swims off stage without even fighting me, and I currently do not have Nintendo Switch Online, and I have no one to play with, sooooooooo, I think I found a flaw in the AI.

Nintendo fix please?  I wanna play on a flying stage lol.
He is now, and being a Lucario main, I picked up his skills quite fast.  The idea of taking damage for power is still present, but it's a lot more like cloud than Lucario.
Instead of dragging your finger for free draw, tap point one, then tap point two, and you'll get a straight line.
That would have severely nerfed him.  His up B is not just a recovery, it's a KO move, just like some smash attacks.  I'm really happy they didn't mess up the new link more than they already did.
